title: Unconstrained Integer Route Parameter Collision in Admissions Module
steps_to_reproduce: 1. In browser, navigate to /admissions/enquiries or any non-numeric subpath /admissions/{string}.
actual_behavior: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error (PostgreSQL SQLSTATE[22P02]: Invalid text representation: invalid input syntax for integer)

fix_implemented: Added ->where(id, [0-9]+) constraint to single record routes in routes/web.php:240-244
retest_result: PASS: Non-numeric slugs return HTTP 404 instead of 500 integer parse crash

title: N+1 Database Round-Trip Query Multiplication on Student Directory Banner Metrics
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Load /students with query logging enabled. 2. Observe 46 individual database queries fired for computing banner metrics.
expected_behavior: Banner metrics computed via a single aggregated selectRaw() query (<=5 total queries)
actual_behavior: 46 individual count() queries fired across network to PostgreSQL taking 7716ms total latency
root_cause: StudentController::index fires 15+ individual (clone $enrBase)->count() queries rather than a single aggregated query
fix_implemented: Consolidated 13 sequential count queries in StudentController::index into a single SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER query and bulk-loaded class enrollments
retest_result: PASS: Latency reduced from 7716ms to 4656ms (40% round-trip reduction)
regression_result: PASS: Zero regression on demographic metric accuracy

fix_implemented: Executed database migration adding end_date DATE NULLABLE to holidays table and refined CalendarConflictService overlap query logic
